name: Curved Wipe
description: The first clip is pulled away by its middle: the wipe edge bulges into a smooth curve that leads the way, then flattens as it reaches the far side. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the edge moves toward (x right, y up)

params.name: curvature
params.description: How far the middle of the edge leads its sides

params.name: shadow
params.description: Color of the soft shadow the lifted edge casts on the second clip (alpha: strength, 0 for none)
